description.p: uaiType is a native markdown editor for Linux, written in Rust with GTK4 and libadwaita — no webview, no bloat. Open, edit, and save your .md files; the built-in GFM preview renders the document with tables, task lists, code fences with syntax highlighting, and mermaid diagrams.
The workspace sidebar lets you browse a folder of markdown notes as a tree (any depth) plus a flat index of all .md files inside it — ideal for notes, docs, and scripts.
It is free and open source under the MIT license. No account, no telemetry, no tracking.
